---
kind: chapter
n: 2
title: The Letter
---

SCENE: The lighthouse kitchen, morning
Grey light comes through the window. The stove is cold.
ON SCREEN: Mara (in her nightshirt, yawning), Tomas (asleep on a chair)
MARA: Wake up. We are opening it now.
TOMAS (annoyed): Five more minutes.
Mara slides a knife under the wax seal. The paper smells of salt.
MARA (thinking): It says to come to the lamp room at midnight.
